title: Ink
description: A point cloud in unit space: the leaf of every form. data/<namespace>/inks/<name>.json. Unknown keys are ignored by the loader, but are rejected here so a typo is visible while typing. Limits: ContentLimits.MAX_INK_POINTS.

items.description: [u, v] or [u, v, w]. When both points and uv are present, points wins.

uv.description: Flat [u0, v0, u1, v1, ...] list. The runtime requires an even length (at most 8192 pairs).

colors.description: Per-point palette index, empty or exactly as long as the point cloud.

sizes.description: Per-point size, empty or exactly as long as the point cloud.

size.description: One size for every point; used only when sizes is absent or empty.
